parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} beep(){try{const parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const beep(){try{const parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton. sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function parts=PARTS;const stage=document.getElementById("stage"),arrows=document.getElementById("arrows");function makeLabels(){const sides={left:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="left"),right:parts.filter(p=>p[4]==="right")};["left","right"].forEach(side=>{const arr=sides[side];arr.forEach((p,j)=>{const i=parts.indexOf(p),el=document.createElement("div");el.className="label "+side;el.textContent=p[0];el.dataset.i=i;el.style.top=(4+j*(91/(arr.length-1)))+"%";el.addEventListener("click",()=>select(i));stage.appendChild(el)})});requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows)}function drawArrows(){arrows.innerHTML=``;document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((el,i)=>{const p=parts[i],side=p[4],r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=((r.left-sr.left+(side==="left"?r.width:0))/sr.width)*100,sy=((r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)/sr.height)*100,ex=p[2],ey=p[3],mx=side==="left"?sx+(ex-sx)*.58:sx-(sx-ex)*.58;const line=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");line.setAttribute("class","arrow");line.setAttribute("marker-end","url(#arrowhead)");line.setAttribute("d",`M ${sx} ${sy} C ${mx} ${sy}, ${mx} ${ey}, ${ex} ${ey}`);arrows.appendChild(line)})}function select(i){const p=parts[i];document.getElementById("selected").textContent=p[0];document.getElementById("info").textContent=p[1];document.querySelectorAll(".label").forEach((e,n)=>e.classList.toggle("active",n===i));beep()}function beep(){try{const c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=260;o.type="sine";g.gain.value=.06;o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.1)}catch(e){}}function scare(){beep();document.body.animate([{filter:"brightness(1)"},{filter:"brightness(3)"},{filter:"brightness(.2)"},{filter:"brightness(1)"}],{duration:700});document.getElementById("selected").textContent="☠ SKELETAL SYSTEM";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton provides support, protects internal organs, enables movement, stores minerals, and contains bone marrow."}function enterSystem(){document.getElementById("mainMenu").classList.add("hidden");document.getElementById("mainPage").classList.remove("hidden");beep();setTimeout(()=>scare(),120)}function showCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="block"}function hideCreator(){document.getElementById("creatorCard").style.display="none"}function creator(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="CREATOR";document.getElementById("info").textContent="DETECIO, LORENZ EMMANUEL C. — Interactive Skeletal System Web Page."}function overall(){document.getElementById("selected").textContent="OVERALL EXPLANATION";document.getElementById("info").textContent="The human skeleton is organized into the axial and appendicular skeleton.
